name: save-boot-7b-world-kalm-long
description: Diagnostic for #140 (why the save-booted world map did not move under the pad in #80 attempt 3). Signs only (-1/0/1) for positions and angles; no coordinate leaves the run. Load as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3). Then 3000 frames (50 s, for a long fade or event), a mark, 300 frames of Up, 300 of Right and 10 still. Reported: wl_state, flags1, and the signs of the change since the mark of pos.vx/vz, altPos.vx/vz, direction and unk3E (rotation).

wl_state.description: World overlay D_800E566C (s32, low half): the world loop's state. WORLD_Main sets it to -15 and WmUpdateWorldState counts it up to 0, then sets 1 (playing) and starts the fade-in; 2 is the menu, 3/8 a field or battle exit, >= 6 leaves the loop. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c WORLD_Main, WmUpdateWorldState.

flags1.description: Player actor + 0x51 flags1: bit 0x10 is set by WmScriptDisableForPcEntity(1) (the script disables the player), bit 0x80 means its position needs recalculating. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.
